items.title: Did Apollo Joint Venture Just Shift UDR Stock's Investment Narrative?
items.summary: UDR, Inc. reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$428.08 million and net income of US$216.09 million, then raised full year guidance after closing a US$2b joint venture with Apollo that expanded capital access and lowered leverage.
